title: Option<Arc<GroupFilter>> used across crate boundaries without type alias
description: The type Option<Arc<GroupFilter>> appears in three places across two crates: ValidationConfig.allowed_groups (stoa_core::validation), PipelineCtx.group_filter (stoa_transit::peering::pipeline), and the local variable in transit main.rs. The semantics are always the same: None means accept all, Some means apply the filter. Without a type alias, there is no way to communicate this convention in the type system, and any site that constructs or passes this value must independently understand the None-means-accept-all convention. A type alias such as type GroupPolicy = Option<Arc<GroupFilter>> defined in stoa_core::wildmat would make the convention visible and searchable, and enable future promotion to a newtype if the semantics need to evolve (e.g. adding a None-means-reject-all mode).
